pest_threshold.subject: ⚠️ Pest alert: {count} insects at {deviceName}

pest_surge.subject: 📈 Sudden rise: {deviceName}
pest_surge.body: Camera {deviceName} ({deviceSerial}) counts {count} insects, up from {previous} {days} days ago (+{pct}%). Check the trap and consider treating early.

image_quality.subject: 📷 Check camera {deviceName}: {issueText}
image_quality.body: The last photos from {deviceName} ({deviceSerial}) show a problem: {issueText}. Insect counts from these photos may be wrong until it is fixed.

pest_threshold_daily.subject: ⚠️ Pest alert: {count} insects on average at {deviceName}
pest_threshold_daily.body: Lure trap {deviceName} ({deviceSerial}) has averaged {count} insects per photo today, at or above your alert threshold of {threshold}.

harvest_ready.subject: 🧺 OK to harvest: {product} ({area})

weather_risk.subject: 🌦️ Weather that suits fruit flies: {farmName}
weather_risk.body: The forecast for {days} at {farmName}: {minTemp}–{maxTemp}°C, humidity up to {humidity}%, ideal for fruit flies to fly and lay eggs. From degree-days, the next wave of adults is due around {waveDate}. Check the traps, collect fallen fruit and get bait sprays ready before those days.
